thread:
ana: hitting a hard regression in json_mode for a customer PROD workload — intermittent 400s and billing spike from retries. request id r-0a1b2c3d4e. payload has nested array of items where some items include extra keys and some are partial. anyone seen parse errors like this?

support-bot: Auto-ticket created: INC-9172. Assigned to support.

kevin: can you paste a minimal repro and the exact error log? also which SDK + streaming options?

ana: (typo) meant ana — sending minimal repro below. happens with SDK v1.12.0, streaming=true, json_mode=strict. error from runtime: \n\n```

REQUEST r-0a1b2c3d4e ERROR: JsonModeParseError: unexpected key 'temp_metadata' in item at array index 2
at runtime/parser/stream_assembler.rs:421

raw stream chunk boundary (truncated):
{"items":[{"id":"itm_1","price":12.5},{"id":"itm_2","price":7.0,"temp_metadata":{"trace":1}},{"id":"itm_3","price":null}
, ...]}
```

ana: customer sees 400s, then client retries 3x which created billing spike. they also reported sometimes items arrive out of order and parser produces "partial object" exceptions.

matt: do you have a raw stream capture? looks like chunking may split objects and our assembler might be merging keys from adjacent items. streaming + continuous batching can interleave shards. can you paste the raw bytes around the split?

ana: pasting sanitized raw stream (newlines added):

```
chunk1: {"items":[{"id":"itm_1","price":12.5},{"id":"itm_2","pr
chunk2: ice":7.0,"temp_metadata":{"trace":1}},{"id":"itm_3","price":null}],"meta":{"batch_id":"b-9001"}}
```

kevin: aha — the client is sending concurrent item streams and our assembler assumes object boundaries align with chunks. when a chunk cut occurs inside a key name (pr
 + ice) it still worked, but the extra key temp_metadata in the middle of the array is flagged by strict schema. two separate problems: 1) boundary assembly bug that can produce partial objects; 2) schema strictness rejects optional extra keys causing parse failure instead of graceful ignore.

lisa: quick mitigation: ask customer to set json_mode to "relaxed" or enable allow_extra_keys for nested arrays. Also temporary client-side throttle (no concurrent writes to same array) reduces interleaving. Example curl repro (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"x-large","json_mode":"strict","input":{"items":[{"id":"itm_1","price":12.5},{"id":"itm_2","price":7.0,"temp_metadata":{"trace":1}},{"id":"itm_3","price":null}]}}'
```

kevin: can you include expected vs actual?

ana: expected 200 + well-formed JSON array of items. actual sometimes 400 with JsonModeParseError or 200 but with items missing/merged fields. Repro rate ~15% under their production concurrency.

infra-bot: trace r-0a1b2c3d4e: runtime assembly module logged KParserError at offset 184: "partial object assembled across chunks"; assembler attempted to merge partial buffers and used optimistic field reconciliation which allowed temp_metadata to appear in the wrong item. Also saw repeated authorization header 401 once when client retried with expired token -> caused some auth failures contributing to retries/billing.

matt: for triage I'll open eng-runtime ticket with dump + parsed offsets. immediate fix options: 1) patch assembler to treat split bytes conservatively (reject partial merges) and return recoverable boundary signal so client can resend only the affected chunk; 2) accept extra keys in nested arrays when json_mode=strict only if they don't violate required fields — but that's risky. prefer (1).

kevin: escalating now. tagging teams: @eng-runtime, @eng-ml (parser), @support (billing). please review INC-9172. billing: flag customer for potential refund on the retry-induced charges.

lisa: customer workaround we recommended: set json_mode=relaxed OR add schema entry for temp_metadata as optional. also rotate auth token to avoid 401s during retries.

ana: attaching small gzipped raw-stream snippet to S3: s3://redwood-support/attachments/r-0a1b2c4e-raw.gz (sanitized).

matt: got it. I'll prioritize a small runtime change to make assembly stricter and add a guarded regression test for interleaved chunking + nested extra keys. planning patch and canary tomorrow.

kevin: thanks all — please keep updates on the ticket. any billing notes, DM me. :eyes:

lisa: thx — adding a short support KB entry with workaround steps and curl example. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks team, customer is in the loop and paused some traffic while we triage. will update INC-9172 with their go/no-go for patch canary.
